hero:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide promotional key art for the WestCose World indie-game portfolio, landscape 16:9.
Primary request: Make this existing coastal little-planet game world look art-directed and commercially compelling, like the hero frame of a polished indie-game trailer.
Input images: Image 1 is the real game world and mandatory layout/landmark reference. Image 2 is a supporting reference for the actual WestCose shop architecture and branding.
Scene: The SAME compact spherical coastal town, winding dark roads, cream low-rise skate/surf storefronts, sandy waterfront, timber pier, red-and-cream lighthouse, palms, evergreen headlands and skate terrain. Keep its recognizable small-planet silhouette and game-scale architecture.
Composition: a close, three-quarter cinematic view of the planet with the shoreline and pier readable in the foreground, town layered behind, lighthouse silhouetted, the full globe comfortably framed rather than distant. A softly atmospheric sea-blue environment replaces the flat gray screenshot background.
Style: premium stylized 3D indie-game promotional render, tactile hand-authored low-poly geometry, crisp silhouettes, cohesive materials, carefully controlled detail; retain this game's stylized character rather than photorealistic city imagery.
Lighting: late afternoon coastal sunlight, warm ivory highlights, deep sea-green shadows, subtle atmospheric depth, luminous turquoise water, restrained filmic grading. Strong focal hierarchy and deliberate contrast, never murky.
Constraints: Use the existing world as the visual truth. Preserve the shop identity, coast, pier and lighthouse. Remove all HUD, menus, debug controls and overlay text. No added people, new districts, vehicles, mountains, floating props, weapons, new attractions or invented game mechanics. No headline, no slogan, no watermark. This is promotional artwork based on the game, not a literal gameplay screenshot. Make a beautiful cohesive finished campaign image.
